traits.height_max_m.note: Abrams vol. 2 (1944), as Holodiscus discolor: a shrub 1 m to 4 m high. Both scans OCR the range badly ('1^ m.' and '14 m.'), so it is read as 1-4 m. Jepson's Manual (1925, p. 479) gives 3 to 6 ft (0.9 m to 1.8 m) for California.

traits.wood_density_basic_kg_m3.note: GWDD v.2.2 species aggregate for Holodiscus discolor (gwddagg_v2.2_species.csv, read): specific gravity 0.69 (wsg_est, the database's hierarchical-model species mean, from 1 record in 1 source); trunks 0.71, branches 0.66. Basic density (oven-dry mass over green volume) is the specific gravity times 1000 kg/m3.

generator.params.path_half.note: A choice of the model's (crown form step B, broadleaf revision 11): the wood from the base at which a shoot's nodes are half as long, fitted so the plant grows to the height of its oldest reference size, with the crown's width left to grow inside the loose region.

generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a tall shrub of arching stems with small, lobed and toothed leaves and drooping, frothy plumes of cream flowers. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 3.2 m tall at 12 years in the open. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: dull green leaves, paler beneath; cream plumes that turn tan. Bark pattern (plant roadmap P4, `bark_pattern`): reddish-brown bark shredding in strips; set from general knowledge of the species, not measured.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

appearance.organs.bloom.note: Its plume drawn flower by flower (spec rework L1c), its kind from its genus's inflorescence, by the rule at the flowering plants: a panicle of 14 branches, each of 5 branches of 7 creamy flowers, by eye, so that it is as dense as the floras say (the Flora of North America gives the genus's panicles 10 to 100 or more flowers and the species' 4 to 20 cm long, multi-branched and dense), each flower about 5 mm across (the Burke Herbarium), hanging from its shoot as before. From floras and extension pages as quoted in search results; the pages themselves were not read. Its flower laid out whorl by whorl (spec rework P5b): five creamy petals between five sepals on a floral cup, twenty stamens and five free pistils, from the characters of Rosaceae and Holodiscus by the rules at the flowering plants.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 318, Holodiscus discolor: flower size 3-3.5 mm.

traits.inflorescence.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 318, Holodiscus discolor: inflorescence panicle.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 318, Holodiscus discolor: inflorescence length 10-25 cm.

traits.inflorescence_posture.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 318, Holodiscus discolor: inflorescence posture nodding.

traits.fruit_type.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019) p. 318, Holodiscus discolor: fruit type aggregate.
